description: Recursively patch a custom chat theme.

name: tavo_message_find
description: Find messages by inclusive range and role, visibility, speaker, or content filters.

name: tavo_message_get
description: Read one message by stable id or drifting index. Id wins.

name: tavo_message_count
description: Count messages in a Tavo chat.

description: Append a user or assistant message with required content.

name: tavo_variable_list
description: List the complete variable tree for one explicit global, chat, or message scope.

name: tavo_variable_get
description: Read a variable by path from one explicit global, chat, or message scope.

name: tavo_variable_set
description: Set a raw JSON variable value in one explicit scope.

name: tavo_variable_update
description: Shallow-merge object variables, or replace other values, in one explicit scope.

name: tavo_variable_unset
description: Remove a variable path from one explicit scope.

name: tavo_memory_get
description: Read long-term memory for a Tavo chat, including whether injection is enabled.

name: tavo_memory_update
description: Update the enabled state and/or replace the long-term memory entries for a Tavo chat.

name: tavo_memory_append
description: Append one or more long-term memory entries without replacing existing entries.

name: tavo_input_get
description: Read the current active chat input box text.

name: tavo_input_set
description: Replace the current active chat input box text.

name: tavo_input_append
description: Append text to the current active chat input box.

name: tavo_input_clear
description: Clear the current active chat input box.

name: tavo_input_send
description: Send the current active chat input through input hooks and the normal chat flow. Returns when accepted, cancelled, busy, or rejected; it does not wait for generation.

name: tavo_generate
description: Run one non-streaming text generation for a Tavo chat. MCP generation does not show a confirmation dialog.

name: tavo_image_generate
description: Generate an image for a Tavo chat and save it as a durable Tavo file. MCP image generation does not show a confirmation dialog.

name: tavo_tts_play
description: Play text with an explicit configured character or persona voice. Returns after the app shared TTS queue accepts playback, not after playback completes. MCP playback does not show a confirmation dialog.

name: tavo_tts_stop
description: Stop active playback and clear the app shared global TTS queue.

name: tavo_plugin_set_enabled

name: tavo_plugin_set_config

name: tavo_plugin_reset_config
